# Guerrilla UI fonts

These five files are copied byte-for-byte from the official Remastered Demo's
`fonts` directory, as locally available on 2026-09-19. They retain their embedded
names, copyright and license metadata. They are distributed under the SIL Open
Font License 1.1 in [OFL.txt](OFL.txt), separately from the engine's GPL license.

| Runtime filename | Embedded family | Copyright |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cwr_body.ttf | Roboto | 2011 The Roboto Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto-classic) |
| cwr_hand.ttf | Caveat | 2014 The Caveat Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/caveat) |
| cwr_mono.ttf | Unuaranga Kuriero | 2015 Quote-Unquote Apps; reserved font name Courier Prime |
| cwr_serif.ttf | Vollkorn | 2018 The Vollkorn Project Authors (https://github.com/FAlthausen/Vollkorn-Typeface) |
| cwr_title.ttf | Oswald | 2016 The Oswald Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/OswaldFont) |

The installer copies this attribution and OFL.txt with the fonts. These are the
families targeted by the engine's font mappings. The old local Classic test bed
used renamed Windows fonts; those files are not distributed by this repository.
